name: Pavlova
instructions:
1. Heat the oven and line a tray with baking paper, drawing a 20 cm circle as a guide.
2. Beat the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoonful at a time, beating until the mixture is thick and glossy and the sugar has dissolved.
3. Whisk in the vinegar, cornflour and vanilla until just combined.
4. Pile the meringue onto the circle and shape into a round with a slight dip in the centre.
5. Bake until firm and dry to the touch, then turn the oven off and leave the pavlova inside to cool completely.
6. Whip the cream to soft peaks, spread over the cooled pavlova and top with fresh fruit just before serving.

steps.text: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Gently fry the sliced garlic and chilli flakes in the olive oil until fragrant.
Toss the drained pasta through the garlic oil with a splash of pasta water.
Stir through the parsley and serve.

name: Simple Tomato Pasta
instructions:
1. Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente.
2. Soften the diced onion and garlic in the olive oil.
3. Stir in the tomato paste, then the canned tomatoes, and simmer to thicken.
4. Toss the drained pasta through the sauce and serve.

steps.text: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente.
Soften the diced onion and garlic in the olive oil.
Stir in the tomato paste, then the canned tomatoes, and simmer to thicken.
Toss the drained pasta through the sauce and serve.

name: Pancakes
instructions:
1. Whisk the flour, milk, eggs and sugar into a smooth batter.
2. Melt a little butter in a pan over medium heat.
3. Pour in a ladle of batter and cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook the other side.
4. Repeat with the rest of the batter and serve.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, milk, eggs and sugar into a smooth batter.
Melt a little butter in a pan over medium heat.
Pour in a ladle of batter and cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook the other side.
Repeat with the rest of the batter and serve.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Heat the oil in a wok over high heat.
2. Scramble the eggs, then push to one side.
3. Add the diced carrot and peas and stir-fry until tender.
4. Add the rice and soy sauce and toss until hot, then stir through the spring onion and serve.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat.
Scramble the eggs, then push to one side of the wok.
Add the diced carrot and peas and stir-fry until tender.
Add the rice and soy sauce and toss until hot, then stir through the spring onion and serve.

name: Beans on Toast
instructions:
1. Warm the baked beans in a saucepan over medium heat.
2. Toast the bread and spread with butter.
3. Spoon the hot beans over the toast and serve.

steps.text: Warm the baked beans in a saucepan over medium heat.
Toast the bread and spread with butter.
Spoon the hot beans over the toast and serve.

name: Tuna Pasta Salad
instructions:
1. Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, then drain and cool slightly.
2. Flake the drained tuna into a bowl with the sweetcorn.
3. Stir through the mayonnaise and sliced spring onion.
4. Fold in the pasta and serve.

steps.text: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, then drain and cool slightly.
Flake the drained tuna into a bowl with the sweetcorn.
Stir through the mayonnaise and sliced spring onion, fold in the pasta and serve.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions:
1. Soften the onion, carrot and garlic in the oil.
2. Add the mince and brown all over.
3. Stir in the tomato paste, canned tomatoes and stock, then simmer to thicken.
4. Meanwhile cook the spaghetti until al dente.
5. Season the sauce and toss through the drained pasta.

steps.text: Soften the diced onion, carrot and garlic in the oil.
Add the mince and brown all over, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomato paste, canned tomatoes and beef stock.
Simmer gently until rich and thickened.
Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Season the sauce, toss through the drained pasta and serve.

name: Chicken & Vegetable Stir-Fry
instructions:
1. Cook the rice.
2. Stir-fry the sliced chicken until golden.
3. Add the vegetables and garlic and stir-fry until just tender.
4. Stir through soy sauce and honey and serve over rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice in a saucepan until fluffy.
Stir-fry the sliced chicken in hot oil until golden and cooked through.
Add the broccoli, carrot, capsicum and garlic; stir-fry until just tender.
Stir through the soy sauce and honey to coat.
Serve the stir-fry over the rice.

name: Sausage & Vegetable Traybake
instructions:
1. Heat the oven.
2. Chop the potatoes, onion and capsicum into chunks and spread on a tray.
3. Nestle the sausages among the veg, drizzle with oil and scatter with herbs.
4. Roast, turning once, until everything is golden and cooked through.

steps.text: Heat the oven and chop the potatoes, onion and capsicum into chunks.
Spread the veg on a tray and nestle the sausages among them.
Drizzle with oil, scatter with herbs and toss to coat.
Roast until golden and cooked through, turning once halfway.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions:
1. Brown the mince with the onion.
2. Stir in the taco seasoning and a splash of water and simmer.
3. Warm the tortillas.
4. Fill with the beef, shredded lettuce, chopped tomato, cheese and sour cream.

steps.text: Brown the mince with the diced onion in a frying pan.
Stir in the taco seasoning with a splash of water and simmer.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave.
Shred the lettuce and chop the tomato.
Fill the tortillas with beef, salad, cheese and sour cream.

name: Macaroni Cheese
instructions:
1. Cook the macaroni until just tender.
2. Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk to make a smooth sauce.
3. Melt in most of the cheese with the mustard.
4. Combine with the pasta, top with remaining cheese and grill until bubbling.

steps.text: Cook the macaroni in salted boiling water until just tender, then drain.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook for a minute.
Gradually whisk in the milk and stir until thickened and smooth.
Stir in most of the cheese and the mustard until melted.
Fold the sauce through the pasta and tip into a baking dish.
Top with the remaining cheese and grill until golden and bubbling.

name: Chicken Fajitas
instructions:
1. Slice the chicken, capsicum and onion.
2. Toss the chicken with the seasoning and fry until golden.
3. Add the vegetables and cook until softened and charred at the edges.
4. Squeeze over lime and serve with warm tortillas.

steps.text: Slice the chicken, capsicum and onion into strips.
Toss the chicken with the fajita seasoning.
Fry the chicken in hot oil until golden and cooked through.
Add the peppers and onion and cook until softened and lightly charred.
Squeeze over the lime and serve with warm tortillas.

name: Cottage Pie
instructions:
1. Boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and milk.
2. Brown the mince with the onion and carrot.
3. Stir in the tomato paste, stock and peas and simmer.
4. Spread the mince in a dish, top with mash and bake until golden.

steps.text: Boil the peeled, chopped potatoes until tender.
Mash the potatoes with the butter and milk; season.
Brown the mince with the diced onion and carrot.
Stir in the tomato paste, stock and peas and simmer until thick.
Spread the mince in a baking dish and top with the mash.
Bake until the top is golden.

name: Mug Mac & Cheese
instructions:
1. Put the macaroni and water in a large mug.
2. Microwave in bursts, stirring, until the pasta is tender and most water is absorbed.
3. Stir in the milk and cheese and microwave briefly until melted and creamy.

steps.text: Put the macaroni and water in a large microwave-safe mug.
Microwave in 1-minute bursts, stirring between, until tender.
Stir in the milk and grated cheese.
Microwave for another 30–60 seconds until melted and creamy.

name: Tuna Melt
instructions:
1. Mix the drained tuna with the mayo.
2. Butter the bread on the outside and fill with tuna and cheese.
3. Fry until golden and the cheese has melted.

steps.text: Mix the drained tuna with the mayonnaise.
Butter the outsides of the bread and fill with tuna and cheese.
Fry over medium heat until golden and the cheese melts, flipping once.

name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions:
1. Scramble the eggs in hot oil, then set aside.
2. Fry the peas briefly, add the rice and heat through.
3. Return the egg, add soy sauce and spring onion and toss.

steps.text: Scramble the eggs in hot oil, then push aside.
Add the peas and cold cooked rice and stir-fry until hot.
Add the soy sauce and sliced spring onion.
Toss everything together and serve.

name: Upgraded Instant Noodles
instructions:
1. Boil the noodles with the frozen vegetables.
2. Crack in the egg and poach in the broth.
3. Stir in the flavour sachet and soy sauce and top with spring onion.

steps.text: Boil the noodles with the frozen vegetables.
Crack the egg into the simmering broth and poach until set.
Stir in the flavour sachet and soy sauce.
Top with sliced spring onion and serve.

name: Cheese & Bean Quesadilla
instructions:
1. Spread beans and cheese over one tortilla and top with the second.
2. Fry until golden, then flip and crisp the other side.
3. Cut into wedges.

steps.text: Spread the beans and cheese over one tortilla and top with the other.
Fry over medium heat until golden underneath.
Flip and crisp the other side until the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
instructions:
1. Toast the bread.
2. Spread with peanut butter.
3. Top with sliced banana and a drizzle of honey.

steps.text: Toast the bread to your liking.
Spread each slice with peanut butter.
Top with sliced banana and drizzle with honey.
